description: See what a thread's changes touch while it works: a live system diagram that tags each new, changed, and impacted part. A background agent reads the conversation, the plan bar, and git diff, and redraws the map after each turn and during long turns. Play a request flow hop by hop, or click a part for its decisions, plan steps, and files. The same map opens in a browser page for a second screen. The mapper is a second agent thread on your provider, so each update costs tokens; it sleeps after 15 idle minutes.
